headline.en: Barcelona play Feyenoord at home at 18:45 on 9 September
headline.es: El Barca juega contra el Feyenoord en casa a las 18:45 del 9 de septiembre

summary.en: UEFA published the league-phase kickoff times on Saturday. Barcelona host Feyenoord at Camp Nou on 9 September at 18:45 CET, the first of eight league-phase games. Galatasaray and Paris Saint-Germain follow as consecutive away weeks in October. Aston Villa and Manchester City visit later. Sporting and Como complete the list.
summary.es: La UEFA publico el sabado los horarios. El Barca recibe al Feyenoord el 9 de septiembre a las 18:45. Luego Galatasaray, PSG, Villa, City, Sporting y Como.

body.en:
UEFA published the league-phase times on Saturday. Barcelona's first match is Feyenoord at Camp Nou on Wednesday 9 September at 18:45. The early kickoff sits after a Liga weekend, which leaves a short turnaround for anyone who starts on the Sunday before.

The rest of the list is public as well. Barcelona go to Galatasaray and then to Paris in consecutive away weeks in October. Aston Villa visit in November. Manchester City visit in December. Sporting away and Como at home complete the eight games. SPORT wrote that the October and December block is the hard part of the run, not the opening night. Eric Garcia is already banned for Feyenoord because of a red card from last season. Rayo Vallecano visit on Monday. That game does not change the European list. It decides who is available nine days later.

headline.en: Eric Garcia is banned for the Feyenoord match
headline.es: Eric Garcia esta sancionado para el partido contra el Feyenoord

summary.en: Eric Garcia will miss Barcelona's first Champions League match. He was sent off last season in the quarter-final second leg at Atletico Madrid. UEFA carry that red card into the next European game. Jules Kounde and Xavi Espart can play on that side on 9 September.
summary.es: Eric Garcia se pierde el primer partido de Champions. Lo expulsaron la temporada pasada en el Metropolitano. Kounde y Espart pueden cubrir esa banda.

body.en:
Eric Garcia is banned for Feyenoord on 9 September. He was sent off last season in the Champions League quarter-final second leg at Atletico Madrid. UEFA rule 63.01 moves a straight red on to the player's next European match. Barcelona went out of that tie, so Garcia never served the ban until now. There is no new red card this season.

Sergi Sole reported the suspension in Mundo Deportivo on Saturday, after UEFA published the kickoff times. Jules Kounde can play on that side if he is fit. Xavi Espart can cover it as well. Flick already used Espart at left-back in Elche. Using him on the right in Europe is possible cover, not his main role. The ban lasts one European night. It becomes tighter if Kounde also misses Liga minutes in the days around that match. Garcia remains available for Liga.

headline.en: Livakovic trained with the first team. He is not listed yet
headline.es: Livakovic entrenó con el primer equipo. Aun no esta inscrito

summary.en: Dominik Livakovic signed until 2030 after a low fixed fee and add-ons to Fenerbahce. He trained with Barcelona's first team on Saturday. Joan Garcia is still first choice after two Liga clean sheets. Whether Livakovic is registered, or loaned, depends on fair play.
summary.es: Livakovic firmo hasta 2030. El sabado trabajo con el primer equipo. Joan Garcia sigue de titular. La ficha depende del fair play.

body.en:
Livakovic signed a contract until 2030. The fee to Fenerbahce is low, with add-ons. He trained with Barcelona's first team on Saturday, which means he is at the club. It does not mean he is on the Liga list. Joan Garcia has started both Liga games and kept two clean sheets. Szczesny is still there as backup. Ter Stegen is on loan at Ajax.

Barcelona already have to register Gordon, Adeyemi, Rodri and Cancelo under the 1:1 rule. A fourth goalkeeper only helps if his name can go on the squad list. If the ratio is tight, a loan is the obvious next step. Mundo Deportivo and MARCA both reported him in Saturday's session. Until LaLiga publishes the registration, the contract is signed and the role is open. Joan Garcia remains the starter for Rayo on Monday.
